displayName: Guitar Coach API - weekly cleanup job failure

documentation.content: The weekly-routine-cleanup Cloud Run Job failed at least once. Backed by job_runs_total{outcome="failure"} (src/weekly-routine-cleanup/weekly-routine-cleanup.service.ts). This job runs on a weekly schedule via Cloud Scheduler, so any failure is actionable immediately rather than waiting for a 'spike' — check `gcloud logging read` for the job's execution ID (correlationId) to see the full failure detail. VERIFY the metric.type filter below in Metrics Explorer before applying (see docs/monitoring/README.md).
